move: phone turns in, route draws with plane, island expands, sheet rises
how: Over a drifting ocean background a 300x620 phone fromTo's rotateY 40 -> 12, x -200 -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1 with 1.1s expo.out, then rocks rotateY 6 / rotateX 3 with a 4s sine.inOut yoyo; a right-side headline rises from yPercent 110 (expo.out) with a kicker and altitude stat. Inside, a generated abstract map (seeded land polygons, grid, roads) settles from scale 1.15 / opacity 0 (power3.out) while a bottom sheet is parked at y 150. From 14% to 66% the cyan route path draws drawSVG 0 -> 100% with power1.inOut as a plane icon (autoRotate) and a white tooltip follow the same bezier with MotionPathPlugin and the sheet's progress bar fills scaleX 0 -> 1; altitude and speed counters climb to 34,000 ft / 512 mph (power2.out) in the tooltip, sheet and side stat; a destination ping ring grows r 6 -> 26 and fades eight times. At 50% the Dynamic Island widens to 170px with back.out(1.5) and shows an ETA; at 66% the sheet rises to y 0 (expo.out) and the status pill turns blue and reads 'Landing'. At 93% the phone turns out rotateY -30, x -220 and fades (expo.in) and the copy slides right.
adapt: Replace the flight number, airports, times, altitude/speed targets, ETA strings, headline and background image; reshape the route path d (both #route and #flown) and reseed the map rng. Keep the 5.2s power1.inOut draw/flight and the 1.1s expo.out entry.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the phone, generates the map SVG from a seeded rng and builds the copy block; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with entry 0-0.11D, draw 0.14D-0.66D, island at 0.5D, sheet at 0.66D and exit at 0.93D. The counter onUpdate uses five document.querySelector calls that must be scoped to el; the motionPath path/align ids must be unique per instance; DrawSVGPlugin and MotionPathPlugin must be registered.
caveats: catalog lists 17s but the file renders 10s
text changes use onComplete/onReverseComplete, so seeks that jump those tweens show stale text
from() tweens on copy and tooltip have default immediateRender
full-frame background image with brightness/saturate filter; drop-shadow filter on the plane
loop does not close: phone turns out
